## Boundaries

- claimAuthority defaults to none.
- HTTP 200 is not claim authority.
- No bid, claim, pay, or POST to third-party claim endpoints.
- mixedScore is displayOnly and is never a gate.
- winProbability stays unknown unless a documented formula is labelled guess
  (diagnostics only; never the Effort field).
